question: The reduction in the external value of the domestic currency is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devaluation of currency.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devaluation of currency**

 
 
• The reduction in the external value of the domestic currency is called the** devaluation of currency.**
 
• ​Devaluation occurs when a country intentionally reduces the value of its currency relative to one or more foreign countries.
 
• The government does this by adjusting the fixed or semi-fixed exchange rate of its currency versus that of another country.
 
• By making its own currency cheaper, the country can boost exports.
 
• At the same time, foreign products become more expensive, so imports fall.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic growth**

 
 
• Economic growth is an increase in the production of goods and services in an economy.
 
• It can be measured in nominal or real (adjusted for inflation) terms. 
 
• Aggregate economic growth is measured in terms of **gross national product (GNP) **or **gross domestic product (GDP).**
 
 
 
• **​Decrease in Inflation**
 
 
• Decrease in inflation is called **deflation**. 
 
• **​**Deflation, or negative inflation, happens when prices generally fall in an economy.
 
• This can be because the supply of goods is higher than the demand for those goods.
